1.text: “ ‘Mwirinde, ntimugakorere ibyiza byanyu imbere y'abantu kugira ngo babarebe, kuko nimugira mutyo ari nta ngororano muzagororerwa na So wo mu ijuru.

2.text: “ ‘Ahubwo nugira ubuntu, ntukavuze ihembe imbere yawe nk'uko indyarya zigira mu masinagogi no mu nzira ngo bashimwe n'abantu. Ndababwira ukuri yuko bamaze kugororerwa ingororano zabo.

3.text: Ahubwo wowe ho nugira ubuntu, ukuboko kwawe kw'ibumoso kwe kumenya icyo ukw'iburyo gukora,

4.text: ahubwo ugire ubuntu bwawe wiherereye. Nuko So ureba ibyiherereye azakugororera.

5.text: “ ‘Nimusenga ntimukamere nk'indyarya, kuko bakunda gusenga bahagaze mu masinagogi no mu nzira ngo abantu babarebe. Ndababwira ukuri yuko bamaze kugororerwa ingororano zabo.

6.text: Wehoho nusenga ujye winjira mu nzu ubanze ukinge urugi, uhereko usenge So mwihereranye. Nuko So ureba ibyiherereye azakugororera.

7.text: “ ‘Namwe nimusenga, ntimukavuge amagambo muyasubiramo hato na hato nk'uko abapagani bagira, bibwira ko kuvuga amagambo menshi ari byo bituma bumvirwa.

8.text: Nuko ntimugase na bo, kuko So azi ibyo mukennye mutaramusaba.

9.text: Nuko musenge mutya muti“ ‘Data wa twese uri mu ijuru,Izina ryawe ryubahwe,

10.text: Ubwami bwawe buze,Ibyo ushaka bibeho mu isi,Nk'uko biba mu ijuru.

11.text: Uduhe none ibyokurya byacu by'uyu munsi,

12.text: Uduharire imyenda yacu,Nk'uko natwe twahariye abarimo imyenda yacu,

13.text: Ntuduhāne mu bitwoshya,Ahubwo udukize Umubi,Kuko ubwami n'ubushobozi n'icyubahiro ari ibyawe,None n'iteka ryose. Amen. ’

14.text: “Kuko nimubabarira abantu ibyaha byabo, na So wo mu ijuru azabababarira namwe,

15.text: ariko nimutababarira abantu, na So na we ntazabababarira ibyaha byanyu.

16.text: “Kandi nimwiyiriza ubusa ntimukabe nk'indyarya zigaragaza umubabaro, kuko bagaragaza umubabaro kugira ngo abantu babarebe ko biyirije ubusa. Ndababwira ukuri yuko bamaze kugororerwa ingororano zabo.

17.text: Ariko weho niwiyiriza ubusa wisige amavuta mu mutwe, wiyuhagire mu maso,

18.text: kugira ngo abantu batamenya ko wiyirije ubusa keretse So uri ahiherereye, kandi So ureba ibyiherereye azakugororera.

19.text: “Ntimukībikire ubutunzi mu isi, aho inyenzi n'ingese ziburya, kandi abajura bacukura bakabwiba.

20.text: Ahubwo mwibikire ubutunzi mu ijuru, aho inyenzi n'ingese zitaburya, n'abajura ntibacukure ngo babwibe,

21.text: kuko aho ubutunzi bwawe buri ari ho n'umutima wawe uzaba.

22.text: “Itabaza ry'umubiri ni ijisho. Ijisho ryawe nirireba neza, umubiri wawe wose uba ufite umucyo,

23.text: ariko niriba ribi, umubiri wawe wose uba ufite umwijima. Nuko umucyo ukurimo nuba umwijima, mbega uwo mwijima uko uba ari mwinshi!

24.text: “Nta wucyeza abami babiri kuko yakwanga umwe agakunda undi, cyangwa yaguma kuri umwe agasuzugura undi. Ntimubasha gukorera Imana n'ubutunzi.

25.text: “Ni cyo gitumye mbabwira nti: ntimukiganyire ngo mutekereze ubugingo muti ‘Tuzarya iki?’ Cyangwa muti ‘Tuzanywa iki?’ Ntimwiganyire ngo mutekereze iby'umubiri wanyu ngo ‘Tuzambara iki?’ Mbese ubugingo ntiburuta ibyokurya, umubiri nturuta imyambaro?

26.text: Nimurebe ibiguruka mu kirere: ntibibiba, ntibisarura, ntibihunika mu bigega, kandi So wo mu ijuru arabigaburira na byo. Mwebwe se ntimubiruta cyane?

27.text: Ni nde muri mwe wiganyira wabasha kwiyunguraho umukono umwe?

28.text: “None se ikibaganyisha imyambaro ni iki? Mutekereze uburabyo bwo mu gasozi uko bumera: ntibugira umurimo, ntibuboha imyenda,

29.text: kandi ndababwira yuko Salomo mu bwiza bwe bwose, atarimbaga nk'akarabyo kamwe ko muri ubu.

30.text: Ariko Imana ubwo yambika ubwatsi bwo mu gasozi ityo, buriho none ejo bakabujugunya mu muriro, ntizarushaho kubambika mwa bafite kwizera guke mwe?

31.text: “Nuko ntimukiganyire mugira ngo ‘Tuzarya iki?’ Cyangwa ngo ‘Tuzanywa iki?’ Cyangwa ngo ‘Tuzambara iki?’

32.text: Kuko ibyo byose abapagani babishaka, kandi So wo mu ijuru azi ko mubikwiriye byose.

33.text: Ahubwo mubanze mushake ubwami bw'Imana no gukiranuka kwayo, ni bwo ibyo byose muzabyongerwa.

34.text: Ntimukiganyire mutekereza iby'ejo, kuko ab'ejo baziganyira iby'ejo. Umunsi wose ukwiranye n'ibibi byawo.
